stories.title: 0061_mafua.md
stories.text: Chon chon gi lala, e gweng' Busolwe nenitiere nyako mane iluongo ni Namagunga.

stories.title: 0061_mafua.md
stories.text: Nohero mafua ahinya. Chieng' moro nodhi kulo e aora miluongo ni Nakwiga.

stories.title: 0061_mafua.md
stories.text: Kane odhi kulo, ne oyudo mafua mane ogombo ahinya, waooooo! ne owacho.

stories.title: 0061_mafua.md
stories.text: Kane odok dala ne okono min gi mondo enbe opidhie mafua e dala gi nikech...............

stories.title: 0099_doli-na-manyinge-azizi.md
stories.text:
Ahere kinde duko nimar
kinde duko osiko ka
obunjo.

stories.title: 0099_doli-na-manyinge-azizi.md
stories.text:
Bang' ka achiweo,
alwoko wang'a bang'e
amanyo.
Kama Azizi nitiere.

stories.title: 0099_doli-na-manyinge-azizi.md
stories.text:
Sama ametho, ko
ametho kanyakla, kod
Azizi.

stories.title: 0099_doli-na-manyinge-azizi.md
stories.text:
Kata sama achamo
nyami bilie, ko amiye
moro.

stories.title: 0099_doli-na-manyinge-azizi.md
stories.text:
To kata kamano, en ok
ocham mare.
Kendo mano kawa kod
wuoro!

stories.title: 0099_doli-na-manyinge-azizi.md
stories.text:
Bang'e amiye, kata
kamano, ok ogo,
“Erokamano.”

stories.title: 0099_doli-na-manyinge-azizi.md
stories.text:
Alwoko Azizi maer
ahinya kapok mamana
olwoka.

stories.title: 0099_doli-na-manyinge-azizi.md
stories.text:
Bang'e arwake nanga
makwar mimar ahero
range makwar.

stories.title: 0099_doli-na-manyinge-azizi.md
stories.text:
Bang'e ka adhi nindo,
adhi kod Azizi kendo
apiele e batha.

stories.title: 0143_mpira-na-marakwar.md
stories.text:
En malo kabisa e boche.

En e wii due.

Osedhi, oonge.

stories.title: 0277_osiepe.md
stories.text: Nyinge gi gin Zizo, Lele, Sisa to gi Ayanda.

stories.title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
stories.text:
Ma en japuoujna to
nyinge Akinyi.
Ohera sidang'.

stories.title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
stories.text:
Japuonj Akinyi puonjaga
nukta kod fuoni mag
wach.
Anyalo wacho a, e, i, o,
u.

stories.title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
stories.text:
Japuonj Akinyi
osepuoujawa range
kaka makwar, mbulu,
alum, ratong', kod
rateng'.

stories.title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
stories.text:
Seche mag ywenyo,
Japuonj Akinyi wernwa
moudo wanindi.
Adier ower wend nindo
mamit.

stories.title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
stories.text:
Wer mamitno iwero kama:
Nindo mayom ka mula
Yie ichiwne wang'i
Mor mogundho riti
Kawang' ichiewo
Nind maber jaherana
Kik iywagi, kendo wang' awerni
Wend nindo mamit sidang'
Ninda! Ninda!

stories.title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
stories.text:
Japuonj Akinyi ong'eyo sigana mathoth.
Oganonwa sigana mopogore pile odiochieng
ka odiochieng ejuma.

stories.title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
stories.text:
Chieng' wuok tich,
oganonwa ewi chuo
mathuondi.

stories.title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
stories.text:
Tich ariyo to oganonwa
e wi nyiri mathuondi.

stories.title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
stories.text:
Tich adek, oganonwa e
wi yore mag wuoth.

stories.title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
stories.text:
Tich ang'wen is
oganonwa ewi wecha
mag pur.

stories.title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
stories.text:
Tich abich to okwayo
moudo wawegi moudo
waganne jowetewa
wawegi.

stories.title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
stories.text:
Adiero japuonjwa ema
oloyo japuonj duto
maniepiny.
Kabedo maduong' to
agomba modo abed
kaka japuonj Akiniyi.
